summary: The prompt over-splits at conditional/causal connectives and interjection boundaries where the following clause still needs the earlier context (pronoun referents, cause-effect, rhetorical negation), producing the worst quality drops. Far more common, though, is under-segmentation: many long sentences with clear low-risk boundaries (leading fillers/topics, repeated relative clauses, stuttered words, sentence-final predicates) are left untagged, forfeiting free latency gains. One reference itself appears mistranslated (rhetorical tag question negated), which should be excluded from scoring.
